prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, refinement of supplied concept. Simplify the supplied «асси» remote desktop app design while preserving its beautiful GRAPHITE surfaces, mint accents, precise Cyrillic typography, two-stroke mint logo, and soft subtle material depth. User likes the visual quality but finds it too complicated. Show the NEW SIMPLIFIED VERSION for desktop and Android side by side in one 1536x1024 landscape image. This is a conceptual screen design, not functional software. Outside caption only «Асси / простой главный экран», small footer «Визуальная концепция · демоданные». Presentation should be elegant, mostly occupied by the app screens, no perspective skew.

Desktop: a COMPACT utility window at left occupying about 65% canvas width, single-column layout, NO sidebar and NO large illustration. Android phone at right about 26% width. Align screen contents to strong grid, generous whitespace, restrained thin separators. Dark graphite palette and mint main action from reference, readable text contrast. Do not make it look like a corporate dashboard or a help-for-family app.

DESKTOP exact hierarchy, top to bottom:
1. Slim header with mint logo and «асси» left, small settings gear then standard window controls at right.
2. ONE clear search/connection field across the content width with magnifier and placeholder «Имя устройства или код», small quiet key hint «Ctrl K». No other major field or callout.
3. Small section label «Ваши устройства», discreet text action «Все устройства» at its right. Below, exactly THREE elegant list rows, each about 74px high, muted surface separation rather than heavily nested cards:
   - outlined laptop icon, title «MacBook Pro», sublabel «macOS», text status «В сети» and a mint connection arrow button.
   - outlined monitor icon, title «Офисный ПК», sublabel «Windows», text status «В сети» and an understated arrow action.
   - outlined phone icon, title «Pixel 9», sublabel «Android», text status «Не в сети» and dim inactive arrow.
No groups, no duplicate recent list, no big selected-device heading, no tabs, no avatars, no images of laptops. Row details and file transfer stay out of this main screen.
4. Bottom utility area, separated from the rows by generous whitespace and a single fine divider. One line has «Ваш код», large readable digits «584 209 176» and a copy icon. On its right or underneath as a single full-width action, one clear outlined button «Предоставить доступ». Do not put any checkbox or permanent consent anywhere.
Only these four content regions. It should feel like an intentionally compact premium app that opens quickly and is instantly understood. Be extremely disciplined about avoiding redundant labels or controls.

ANDROID: same identity, compact single-column screen. Header logo «асси» with small settings gear. The same search field «Имя устройства или код». Label «Ваши устройства». Same three rows but sized comfortably for touch and screen width; each row has icon, title, OS, small status text and arrow. No filter chips, no sidebar, no bottom navigation bar because there is only one main task. At bottom a neat «Ваш код» plus «584 209 176» and copy button, then a wide outlined or lightly mint-filled button «Предоставить доступ». Keep normal Android system status and gesture bar. No help language, marketing copy, timing metrics, charts, laptop hero image, extra groups, or duplicate headings. Clear readable Russian text, consistent icons, calm visual hierarchy, less UI than the reference.
